title: C rpl: SF assignment module — 0x14 ASSIGNED_SF TLV make/parse + effective_sf state machine + sf_assignment.json host consumer (slice 1 of skab.1)
description: Decompose-first slice of skab.1. Pure module, no modem wiring: C port of rust/lichen-core/src/sf_assignment.rs — constants (DIO_OPTION_ASSIGNED_SF=0x14), is_valid_sf (7..=12), make_assigned_sf_option ([0x14,1,sf]), parse_assigned_sf_option (type/len/sf checks), assigned_sf_hash_based (7 + lichen_hash_32(IID)%6), effective_sf state struct (assigned_sf_dio, joined) with Rust's priority: assigned 7..=12 -> MUST use; else !joined -> 10; else hash fallback. Placement: lichen/subsys/lichen/rpl/rpl_sf_assignment.{c,h}; hash via existing lichen_hash_32 (link/hash32.c, FNV-1a32). Host CTest lichen/tests/rf_sf_assignment consuming test/vectors/sf_assignment.json (hash_32, assigned_sf per IID; plus make/parse TLV boundaries incl. invalid SF 6/13, wrong type/len). Remaining slices of skab.1 (0x14 parse wired into C DIO RX + lora_l2 modem config applying effective SF) stay with the parent.
